measures.title: Santa Clara — local ballot proposition
measures.text: Shall Santa Clara City, Utah, be authorized to impose a local sales and use tax of up to 1.0% on taxable transactions within the City to fund emergency services, including fire protection, ambulance services, emergency medical services, personnel, equipment, facilities, and related operational costs, as authorized by Utah Code 59-12-2402?

measures.title: Virgin — local ballot proposition
measures.text: Shall Virgin Town, Washington County, Utah, increase the Resort Communities Sales and Use Tax rate by an additional one-half percent (0.5%), as authorized by Utah Code Section 59-12-402, to be collected on taxable transactions within Virgin Town?

measures.title: Washington — local ballot proposition
measures.text: Shall Washington City impose an additional .67% (1.0% total) Emergency Services Sales and Use Tax on taxable sales within the City to fund emergency services such as fire protection, ambulance service, and emergency medical response? If approved, the City Council has expressed its intent to reduce the City portion of property taxes by 50%, subject to Truth-in-Taxation requirements.
